big_case.notes: Independent read from the questions presented, the docket, and the outcome: a private-investor challenge to FHFA's assessment-based funding under the Appropriations Clause and nondelegation. The institutional stakes of a merits ruling would have been real (FHFA is the conservator of Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac and the theory reaches every non-appropriated financial regulator), but the question was substantially settled by CFPB v. CFSA (2024) and FCC v. Consumers' Research (2025), the petition drew no amicus support, the panel below was unanimous and published, and the Court denied at its first substantive conference with no noted dissent or statement. A response request after the SG's waiver is the one sign of attention. Modest significance as the case actually played out.
